title: Pure Curse of Dragon
summary: Yugi's Curse of Dragon and Gaia the Dragon Champion Fusion OTK build with generic staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Artillery Catapult Turtle and Galloping Gaia pair Gaia Knights with Level 5 Curse of Dragon monsters, fusing via Spiral Fusion into 5200 ATK Dragon Champions that attack monsters twice.

summary.title: Starters
points: Artillery Catapult Turtle Tributes 1 monster (including itself) to Special Summon any Gaia the Fierce Knight monster or Level 5 Dragon monster (Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon) directly from the Deck.

Galloping Gaia reveals a Gaia the Fierce Knight in your hand to search a Level 5 Dragon, or reveals a Level 5 Dragon to search a Gaia the Fierce Knight, and locks the opponent out of activating cards or effects during the Battle Phase while Gaia the Dragon Champion is in your Monster Zone.

Gateway to Chaos searches a Gaia the Fierce Knight monster on activation, while Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon searches any Spell or Trap that mentions Gaia the Dragon Champion (Spiral Fusion, Galloping Gaia, Spiral Reborn, or Spiral Discharge) on Normal or Special Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Galloping Gaia + Any Gaia or Curse of Dragon
steps: Activate Galloping Gaia, reveal Gaia the Magical Knight (or Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon) in your hand, and search the missing partner from the Deck.
Normal Summon Gaia the Magical Knight without Tributing and use its effect to Special Summon Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon from your hand or GY in Defense Position.

Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon searches Spiral Fusion; activate Spiral Fusion to fuse both into Gaia the Magical Knight of Dragons (or Sky Galloping Gaia the Dragon Champion) at 5200 ATK with two monster attacks.

summary.title: Bosses & Battle OTK
points: Gaia the Magical Knight of Dragons (treated as Gaia the Dragon Champion) loses 2600 ATK as a Quick Effect during the Main Phase to destroy any other card on the field, and gains 2600 ATK whenever it destroys an opponent's monster by battle.
Sky Galloping Gaia the Dragon Champion searches Spiral Spear Strike from the Deck or GY on Special Summon and changes an opposing monster's battle position when it declares an attack.

Curse of Dragon, the Magical Knight Dragon recovers a Spell/Trap mentioning Gaia the Dragon Champion from the GY on Special Summon and banishes materials from the GY to Fusion Summon a Level 7 Dragon Champion, while Curse of Dragonfire fuses using field materials without a Spell.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Support
points: Spiral Fusion Fusion Summons any Dragon Fusion Monster and grants Gaia the Dragon Champion +2600 ATK and up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase.

Spiral Spear Strike grants piercing battle damage to Gaia the Dragon Champion and draws 2 cards (then discards 1) whenever it inflicts piercing damage, while Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon in the GY can negate all face-up monsters your Dragon Champion battles.

Soldier Gaia the Fierce Knight Tributes a Dragon Fusion Monster as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself and flip an Attack Position monster to Defense Position, and Spiral Reborn revives a Level 7 or lower Dragon or Gaia the Dragon Champion.

allow.Soldier Gaia the Fierce Knight: Tributes a Dragon Fusion Monster as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself and flips an Attack Position monster to Defense Position.
allow.Artillery Catapult Turtle: Tributes itself to Special Summon any Level 5 Dragon monster (Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon or Magical Knight Dragon) directly from the Deck.
allow.Gateway to Chaos: Field Spell that searches Gaia the Magical Knight on activation and removes counters to search Spiral Fusion.

main: Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon
Core Level 5 DARK Dragon that searches any Spell/Trap mentioning Gaia the Dragon Champion on Normal/Special Summon, and negates all face-up monsters a Dragon Champion battles if sent to the GY.
Curse of Dragonfire
Level 5 DARK Dragon that destroys a Field Spell on Summon and Fusion Summons a Dragon Champion using monsters you control without a Fusion Spell.
Curse of Dragon
Classic Level 5 WIND Dragon Normal Monster that serves as a target for Artillery Catapult Turtle and Unexpected/Fusion synergies.
Gaia the Magical Knight
Can be Normal Summoned without Tributing and Special Summons a Level 5 Dragon (Curse of Dragon) from your hand or GY in Defense Position.
Soldier Gaia the Fierce Knight
Tributes a Dragon Fusion Monster as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself and flips an Attack Position monster to Defense Position.
Artillery Catapult Turtle
One-card combo starter that tributes itself to summon Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon directly from the Deck.
Galloping Gaia
Continuous Spell that reveals a Curse of Dragon in hand to search a Gaia the Fierce Knight (or vice versa) and prevents the opponent from activating effects during the Battle Phase.
Spiral Fusion
Signature Fusion Spell that summons a Dragon Fusion Monster and gives Gaia the Dragon Champion +2600 ATK (to 5200 ATK) and two attacks on monsters.
Spiral Spear Strike
Continuous Spell that grants piercing battle damage to Gaia the Dragon Champion and draws 2 cards (discarding 1) when it inflicts piercing damage.
Spiral Reborn
Revives a Level 7 or lower Dragon or Gaia the Dragon Champion and protects it from targeting and destruction.
Spiral Discharge
Trap that protects Gaia the Dragon Champion from targeting and destroys a card when it attacks a monster.
Gateway to Chaos
Searches Gaia the Magical Knight on activation.
extra: Gaia the Magical Knight of Dragons
Signature Level 7 Dragon Fusion boss (Gaia + Level 5 Dragon) that loses 2600 ATK as a Quick Effect to destroy any card on the field, then gains 2600 ATK on battle destruction.
Curse of Dragon, the Magical Knight Dragon
Level 5 DARK Dragon Fusion Monster that recovers a Spell/Trap mentioning Gaia and fuses from the GY.
Sky Galloping Gaia the Dragon Champion
Level 7 Dragon Fusion that searches Spiral Spear Strike on Summon and changes an opponent's monster's battle position when declaring an attack.
Classic Fusion of Gaia the Fierce Knight + Curse of Dragon.
